title: Developmental Milestones 0 to 5 Years: What Is Typical, What Is a Flag

hook.en: Is a 15-month-old who is not yet walking late, or normal? Slide through the first five years, switch on "born early" and see the milestone checklist change with the corrected age.
hook.ur: Kya 15 mahine ka bachcha jo abhi chalta nahi late hai ya normal? Pehle paanch saal slide karein, "qabl-az-waqt paida" on karein aur corrected age ke saath milestone checklist badalti dekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll name the key motor, language, social and thinking milestones at each checkpoint from 2 months to 5 years, correct the age of a baby born early, and spot the flags that need a prompt referral.
goal.ur: End tak aap 2 mahine se 5 saal tak har checkpoint ke aham motor, zubaan, samaji aur sochne ke milestones batayenge, qabl-az-waqt paida bachay ki umar corrected karenge, aur woh flags pehchanenge jin par jaldi referral chahiye.

text.en: A **milestone** is a skill that most children show by a certain age. The current US (CDC 2022) checklists use ages at which **at least 3 in 4 children** have achieved the skill, so missing one is a reason to look closer, not proof of a problem. The checkpoints are 2, 4, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 and 24 months, then 30 months, 3, 4 and 5 years, in four domains: **movement**, **language and communication**, **social and emotional**, and **thinking and learning**. The domains develop together: a child who cannot sit may also explore objects less, and a child with a hearing problem may be late with speech.
text.ur: **Milestone** woh hunar hai jo zyada tar bachay ek khaas umar tak dikhate hain. Maujooda US (CDC 2022) checklists un umron ka istemal karti hain jin tak **kam az kam 4 mein se 3 bachay** woh hunar hasil kar chuke hotay hain, is liye ek ka na hona gour se dekhne ki wajah hai, masle ka saboot nahi. Checkpoints 2, 4, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 aur 24 mahine, phir 30 mahine, 3, 4 aur 5 saal hain, chaar domains mein: **harkat**, **zubaan aur communication**, **samaji aur jazbati**, aur **sochna aur seekhna**. Domains saath saath barhte hain: jo bachcha baith nahi sakta woh cheezon ko kam explore bhi kar sakta hai, aur sunne ki kami wala bachcha bolne mein late ho sakta hai.

text.en: Think of milestones as **bus stops on a route**, not a train timetable. Most children reach the same stops in the same order, and some arrive a little early or late. What matters is whether the bus is still moving forward, whether it skips a whole section of the route (for example it never rolls or crawls but sits late), and whether it ever drives backwards (losing a skill). A bus that is a few minutes late at one stop is normal. A bus that stops moving, or reverses, needs a mechanic.
text.ur: Milestones ko **raaste par bus stops** samjhein, train ka waqt-nama nahi. Zyada tar bachay wahi stops ek hi tarteeb mein pohanchte hain, kuch thora jaldi ya der se. Aham yeh hai ke bus abhi aage barh rahi hai ya nahi, kya woh raaste ka poora hissa chhor deti hai (maslan kabhi palatta ya rengta nahi magar der se baithta hai), aur kya woh kabhi ulta chalti hai (hunar kho dena). Ek stop par chand minute late bus normal hai. Jo bus ruk jaye ya ulti chalay usay mechanic chahiye.

intro.en: Slide the age or tap a checkpoint. Filter by domain to follow one thread, such as movement, across the years. Then switch on "Born early by 8 weeks" and see how the milestone shown for a 6-month-old baby becomes the 4-month list. The red box lists the flags to look for at that checkpoint.
intro.ur: Umar slide karein ya kisi checkpoint par tap karein. Domain se filter kar ke ek dhaaga (maslan harkat) saalon mein follow karein. Phir "8 hafte pehle paida" on karein aur dekhein ke 6 mahine ke bachay ka milestone 4 mahine ki list ban jata hai. Laal box us checkpoint ke flags batata hai.

question.en: A baby was born at 32 weeks (8 weeks early) and is now 6 months old by the calendar. Which milestones should you compare her with?
question.ur: Ek bachchi 32 hafte (8 hafte pehle) paida hui aur calendar ke hisab se ab 6 mahine ki hai. Aap use kin milestones se compare karenge?

text.en: The 4-month milestones (corrected age: 6 months minus about 2 months)
text.ur: 4 mahine ke milestones (corrected age: 6 mahine minus taqreeban 2 mahine)

feedback.en: Yes — until 24 months we correct for prematurity: calendar age minus the weeks born early (8 weeks is about 2 months).
feedback.ur: Haan — 24 mahine tak hum qabl-az-waqt paidaish ka correction karte hain: calendar umar minus pehle paida hone ke hafte (8 hafte taqreeban 2 mahine).

text.en: The 6-month milestones, because that is her real age
text.ur: 6 mahine ke milestones, kyunke yeh us ki asal umar hai

feedback.en: A baby born early has had less time to develop outside the womb, so judge her by corrected age until 2 years.
feedback.ur: Qabl-az-waqt paida bachay ko pait ke bahar barhne ka kam waqt mila, is liye 2 saal tak usay corrected umar se parkhein.

text.en: The 9-month milestones, to be safe
text.ur: 9 mahine ke milestones, ehtiyat ke taur par

feedback.en: That would label a normal baby as delayed. Correct downwards, never upwards.
feedback.ur: Isse normal bachay ko late samjha jayega. Correction neechay ki taraf karte hain, upar ki taraf nahi.

hint.en: Subtract the weeks born early (8 weeks is about 2 months).
hint.ur: Pehle paida hone ke hafte minus karein (8 hafte taqreeban 2 mahine).

text.en: **Movement is the physiotherapist's thread.** At 2 months the baby lifts the head on the tummy; at 4 months holds it steady and pushes up on the elbows; at 6 months rolls tummy-to-back and sits leaning on the hands; at 9 months sits alone and gets into sitting by herself; at 12 months pulls to stand and cruises; at 15 months takes a few steps; at 18 months walks alone and climbs on a couch; at 2 years runs and kicks a ball; at 3 years uses a fork; at 5 years hops on one foot. The **order** matters as much as the age: head, trunk, then legs; crawling and cruising prepare for walking; hand skills move from fisting to a pincer grip.
text.ur: **Harkat physiotherapist ka dhaaga hai.** 2 mahine par bachcha pait ke bal sar uthata hai; 4 mahine par sar thamta aur kohniyon par uthta hai; 6 mahine par pait se kamar par palatta aur haathon ke sahare baithta hai; 9 mahine par akela baithta hai aur khud baithne ki position mein aata hai; 12 mahine par pakar kar khara hota aur cruise karta hai; 15 mahine par kuch qadam leta hai; 18 mahine par akela chalta aur sofa par chadhta hai; 2 saal par bhagta aur ball ko laat marta hai; 3 saal par kanta istemal karta hai; 5 saal par ek paaon par hop karta hai. **Tarteeb** bhi umar jitni aham hai: sar, dhar, phir taangein; rengna aur cruise karna chalne ki tayyari hain; haath ki maharat mutthi se pincer grip tak jati hai.

question.en: A 16-month-old is not walking yet but cruises along furniture, babbles, points and plays peek-a-boo. What is the best response?
question.ur: 16 mahine ka bachcha abhi chalta nahi magar furniture pakar kar cruise karta hai, babbling karta, ishara karta aur peek-a-boo khelta hai. Behtareen jawab kya hai?

text.en: Diagnose cerebral palsy because he is late
text.ur: Late hone par cerebral palsy ki tashkhees kar dein

feedback.en: One late milestone is not a diagnosis. Look at the whole picture: tone, asymmetry, other domains, loss of skills.
feedback.ur: Ek late milestone tashkhees nahi. Poori tasveer dekhein: tone, asymmetry, doosre domains, hunar ka khona.

text.en: Reassure, but arrange a review if he is still not walking by about 18 months, or if any skill is lost or asymmetry appears
text.ur: Tasalli dein, magar 18 mahine tak bhi na chale, ya koi hunar kho jaye, ya asymmetry nazar aaye to review karwayein

feedback.en: Yes — the WHO study found that healthy children walk alone anywhere from about 8 to 18 months. He is progressing, so this is a "watch and review", not an alarm.
feedback.ur: Haan — WHO ki study mein sehatmand bachay taqreeban 8 se 18 mahine tak kabhi bhi akelay chalte paye gaye. Woh aage barh raha hai, is liye yeh "dekhein aur review karein" hai, alarm nahi.

text.en: Tell the parents to buy a baby walker so he learns
text.ur: Walidain se kahein ke baby walker kharidein taake woh seekh jaye

feedback.en: Baby walkers do not speed up walking and cause injuries. Floor time and supported standing are better.
feedback.ur: Baby walkers chalna jaldi nahi sikhate aur chotein lagate hain. Farsh par waqt aur sahare se khara hona behtar hai.

text.en: **"Head at 2, props at 4, sits at 6 to 9, stands at 12, walks by 18, hops by 5."** A quick spine for the motor story: head lift at 2 months, elbows up at 4, rolling and leaning-sit at 6, independent sitting by 9, pulling to stand at 12, walking alone by 18, hopping at 5 years.
text.ur: **"2 par sar, 4 par kohni, 6 se 9 baithna, 12 par khara hona, 18 tak chalna, 5 tak hop."** Motor kahani ki reerh: 2 mahine sar uthana, 4 par kohniyan, 6 par palatna aur sahare se baithna, 9 tak akela baithna, 12 par pakar kar khara hona, 18 tak akela chalna, 5 saal par hop.

title.en: Typical variation versus a flag at the same age
title.ur: Usi umar par aam farq aur flag

rows.en: Holds the head steady, hands to the mouth, pushes up on the elbows
rows.ur: Sar thamta hai, haath munh tak, kohniyon par uthta hai

rows.en: Poor head control, fisted hands that never open, one side moves less
rows.ur: Sar par qaboo nahi, band mutthi jo kabhi nahi khulti, ek side kam hilti hai

rows.en: Sits without support, passes a toy hand to hand, babbles 'mamama'
rows.ur: Sahare ke baghair baithta, khilona haath badalta, 'mamama'

rows.en: Cannot sit even with support, one hand unused, no babbling
rows.ur: Sahare se bhi nahi baithta, ek haath istemal nahi, babbling nahi

rows.en: Walks alone, scribbles, three or more words, points to show you things
rows.ur: Akela chalta, lakeerein, teen ya zyada alfaaz, cheezein dikhane ko ishara

rows.en: Not walking, very few words, no pointing, or any loss of skills
rows.ur: Chalta nahi, bohat kam alfaaz, ishara nahi, ya koi hunar kho dena

text.en: **Using the wrong age or one skill alone.** Forgetting to correct a premature baby's age makes healthy children look late, and judging by a single milestone misses the pattern. The commonest clinical errors are: waiting to see "if he grows out of it" past the limits, ignoring **asymmetry** (a strong hand preference before 12 months suggests weakness on the other side), and dismissing a **loss of skills** as a phase. Another trap is relying on parents' reports alone: watch the child play and move.
text.ur: **Ghalat umar ya sirf ek hunar par bharosa.** Qabl-az-waqt bachay ki umar correct na karne se sehatmand bachay late lagte hain, aur sirf ek milestone dekhne se pattern chhoot jata hai. Aam clinical ghaltiyan: had se zyada intezaar karna "shayad theek ho jaye", **asymmetry** ko nazar-andaz karna (12 mahine se pehle ek haath ko majboot taraseeh doosri taraf ki kamzori dikhati hai), aur **hunar kho dene** ko ek daur samajh kar taal dena. Ek aur jaal: sirf walidain ki report par bharosa: bachay ko khelte aur harkat karte khud dekhein.

title.en: A quick developmental screen in the clinic

steps.title: Get the exact age and correct it
steps.detail: Date of birth, weeks of prematurity, then the corrected age under 24 months. || Sahi umar lein aur correct karein

steps.title: Ask about all four domains
steps.detail: Movement, language, social play and thinking, plus hearing, vision and any lost skills. || Chaaron domains poochein

steps.title: Watch the child, not the questionnaire
steps.detail: Place a toy, sit him up, roll him, offer a block: observe the quality, symmetry and effort of each skill. || Bachay ko dekhein, questionnaire ko nahi

steps.title: Look at tone, posture and reflexes
steps.detail: Floppy or stiff? Does the baby favour one side? Are primitive reflexes timely? || Tone, posture aur reflexes dekhein

steps.title: Decide: reassure, review or refer
steps.detail: Reassure with a date to recheck; refer promptly for loss of skills, asymmetry, abnormal tone, hearing or vision concern, or clear delay in several domains. || Faisla: tasalli, review ya refer

text.en: **Write what you saw, not just "delayed".** "Corrected age 6 months (born at 32 weeks). Rolls tummy to back to the left but not the right, sits only with arm propping, strong right-hand preference. Plan: review in 4 weeks; refer to paediatric neurology if the asymmetry persists." Always tell parents what you saw, what is normal, what you will watch for, and give a date. A clear plan reduces anxiety more than "it is probably fine".
text.ur: **"Delayed" nahi, jo dekha woh likhein.** "Corrected age 6 mahine (32 hafte par paida). Tummy se kamar par sirf left taraf palatta hai, right nahi, sirf bazoo ke sahare baithta hai, right haath ko majboot taraseeh. Plan: 4 hafte mein review; asymmetry rahi to paediatric neurology refer." Hamesha walidain ko batayein ke aap ne kya dekha, kya normal hai, kis par nazar rakhenge, aur tareekh dein. Saaf plan "shayad theek hai" se zyada pareshani kam karta hai.

text.en: The **WHO Multicentre Growth Reference Study** followed healthy breastfed children in six countries and found wide windows for gross-motor milestones: for example, walking alone between about **8 and 18 months**, standing alone between about 7 and 17 months. The 2022 CDC milestone revision moved to ages by which **75% or more** of children have the skill, so that a missing milestone more reliably prompts a conversation. Developmental screening with a validated tool at set ages, together with surveillance (watching the child at every visit), is the recommended approach.
text.ur: **WHO Multicentre Growth Reference Study** ne chhe mulkon ke sehatmand, maa ka doodh peenay wale bachon ko follow kiya aur gross-motor milestones ke liye wasee windows paye: maslan akela chalna taqreeban **8 se 18 mahine**, akela khara hona taqreeban 7 se 17 mahine. 2022 ki CDC milestone nazar-e-sani ab un umron par aa gayi jin tak **75% ya zyada** bachay hunar sikh lete hain, taake koi milestone na hona zyada bharosay se baat shuru karne ka sabab bane. Muqarrar umron par validated tool se developmental screening aur saath surveillance (har visit par bachay ko dekhna) ki sifarish ki jati hai.

text.en: **Refer promptly (do not wait) for:** any **loss of a skill the child already had**, no head control by 4 months, not sitting with support by 9 months, not walking by 18 months, a strong hand preference before 12 months, floppy or very stiff tone, no babbling by 12 months or no words by 18 months, no response to sound, poor eye contact or social smile, or head size crossing percentile lines. Parents' worry about development is itself a reason to look carefully. Any regression with seizures, vomiting or a bulging fontanelle is an emergency.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein (intezaar na karein):** **koi hunar jo bachay mein pehle tha usay kho dena**, 4 mahine tak sar par qaboo nahi, 9 mahine tak sahare se bhi nahi baithta, 18 mahine tak nahi chalta, 12 mahine se pehle ek haath ko majboot taraseeh, dheela ya bohat sakht tone, 12 mahine tak babbling nahi ya 18 mahine tak alfaaz nahi, awaaz par rad-e-amal nahi, nazar milana ya muskurahat kam, ya sar ka size percentile lines paar kare. Walidain ki developmental pareshani khud bhi gour se dekhne ki wajah hai. Regression ke saath daure, ulti ya ubhra hua fontanelle emergency hai.

prompt.en: Typical variation or a flag? Sort the finding.
prompt.ur: Aam farq ya flag? Finding sort karein.

text.en: A 14-month-old who is bottom-shuffling instead of crawling and cruising well
text.ur: 14 mahine ka bachcha jo rengne ki jagah bottom-shuffle karta hai aur achi tarah cruise karta hai

why.en: Bottom-shufflers often walk later but are typical if everything else is on track.
why.ur: Bottom-shufflers aksar der se chalte hain magar baqi sab theek ho to typical hain.

text.en: A 3-month-old who looks at faces and smiles
text.ur: 3 mahine ka bachcha jo chehron ko dekhta aur muskurata hai

why.en: Watching faces and social smiling are typical in the first months.
why.ur: Chehron ko dekhna aur muskurana pehle mahinon mein typical hai.

text.en: A 10-month-old who uses only the left hand and keeps the right fisted
text.ur: 10 mahine ka bachcha jo sirf left haath istemal karta hai aur right mutthi band rakhta hai

why.en: A strong hand preference this early suggests weakness on the other side.
why.ur: Itni jaldi ek haath ko majboot taraseeh doosri taraf ki kamzori dikhati hai.

text.en: A 20-month-old who used to say five words and now says none
text.ur: 20 mahine ka bachcha jo paanch alfaaz kehta tha aur ab koi nahi kehta

why.en: Any loss of a skill needs a prompt medical review.
why.ur: Koi bhi hunar kho jana foran medical review maangta hai.

text.en: A baby born at 34 weeks who is not yet rolling at 4 months by the calendar
text.ur: 34 hafte par paida bachcha jo calendar ke hisab se 4 mahine mein abhi palatta nahi

why.en: Corrected age is about 2 months, so rolling is not yet expected.
why.ur: Corrected umar taqreeban 2 mahine hai, is liye palatna abhi expected nahi.

question.en: Why do we only correct for prematurity until about 24 months?
question.ur: Hum qabl-az-waqt paidaish ka correction sirf taqreeban 24 mahine tak kyun karte hain?

answer.en: Corrected age exists because a baby born early has had less time to develop. The few weeks of difference matter a lot at 4 months (about half the age) but become a small fraction of the age later: 8 weeks out of 24 months is roughly 8%, and by 3 years it is too small to change the picture. Beyond about 2 years, calendar age is used, although a very preterm child may still need a little patience in some skills.
answer.ur: Corrected age is liye hai ke qabl-az-waqt paida bachay ko barhne ka kam waqt mila. Chand hafton ka farq 4 mahine par bohat matlab rakhta hai (taqreeban aadhi umar) magar baad mein umar ka chhota sa hissa reh jata hai: 24 mahine mein 8 hafte taqreeban 8% hain, aur 3 saal tak itna chhota ke tasveer nahi badalta. Taqreeban 2 saal ke baad calendar umar istemal hoti hai, halaanke bohat qabl-az-waqt bachay ko kuch hunaron mein thori sabar ki zaroorat ho sakti hai.

question.en: At which age should a child typically hop on one foot?
question.ur: Aam taur par bachcha kis umar mein ek paaon par hop karta hai?

text.en: About 2 years
text.ur: Taqreeban 2 saal

feedback.en: At 2 years children run and kick a ball, but one-leg hopping needs much more balance and strength.
feedback.ur: 2 saal par bachay bhagte aur ball ko laat marte hain, magar ek taang par hop karne ke liye kahin zyada balance aur taqat chahiye.

text.en: About 12 months
text.ur: Taqreeban 12 mahine

feedback.en: At 12 months a child is pulling to stand and cruising, not hopping.
feedback.ur: 12 mahine par bachcha pakar kar khara hota aur cruise karta hai, hop nahi.

text.en: About 5 years
text.ur: Taqreeban 5 saal

feedback.en: Yes — hopping on one foot (a test of single-leg balance and strength) appears at the 5-year checkpoint in the CDC list.
feedback.ur: Haan — ek paaon par hop karna (single-leg balance aur taqat ka test) CDC list mein 5 saal ke checkpoint par aata hai.

summary.en: Milestones are skills most children show by an age (CDC 2022: three in four or more). Use the checkpoints for four domains, and watch the order of skills, not one skill alone.
summary.ur: Milestones woh hunar hain jo zyada tar bachay ek umar tak dikhate hain (CDC 2022: chaar mein se teen ya zyada). Chaar domains ke checkpoints istemal karein, aur sirf ek hunar nahi, hunaron ki tarteeb dekhein.

summary.en: Correct the age of a baby born early (calendar age minus the weeks early) until 24 months, and never correct upward.
summary.ur: Qabl-az-waqt paida bachay ki umar 24 mahine tak correct karein (calendar umar minus pehle paida hone ke hafte), aur upar ki taraf kabhi correct na karein.

summary.en: Refer promptly for lost skills, asymmetry, abnormal tone, no walking by 18 months, no babbling by 12 months or any hearing or vision concern.
summary.ur: Hunar kho dene, asymmetry, ghair-mamooli tone, 18 mahine tak chalna nahi, 12 mahine tak babbling nahi ya sunne ya nazar ke khadshay par foran refer karein.

front.en: What does a milestone mean in the 2022 CDC checklists?
front.ur: 2022 CDC checklists mein milestone ka kya matlab hai?

back.en: A skill that at least 75% of children (three in four) show by that age.
back.ur: Aisa hunar jo us umar tak kam az kam 75% bachay (chaar mein se teen) dikhate hain.

front.en: How do you correct a premature baby's age?
front.ur: Qabl-az-waqt bachay ki umar kaise correct karte hain?

back.en: Calendar age minus the number of weeks (or months) born early, applied until 24 months.
back.ur: Calendar umar minus pehle paida hone ke hafte (ya mahine), 24 mahine tak lagayein.

front.en: Give three flags that need prompt referral.
front.ur: Teen flags batayein jin par jaldi referral chahiye.

back.en: Loss of a skill; strong hand preference before 12 months; not walking by 18 months (also no babbling by 12 months, abnormal tone).
back.ur: Hunar kho dena; 12 mahine se pehle ek haath ko majboot taraseeh; 18 mahine tak chalna nahi (saath 12 mahine tak babbling nahi, ghair-mamooli tone).

front.en: What did the WHO study show about walking age?
front.ur: WHO study ne chalne ki umar ke bare mein kya dikhaya?

back.en: Healthy children walked alone anywhere between about 8 and 18 months: the normal window is wide.
back.ur: Sehatmand bachay taqreeban 8 se 18 mahine ke beech kabhi bhi akelay chale: normal window wasee hai.
